desc: Parse K, S, T from input.
If abs(len(S) - len(T)) > K, print "No" and exit.
Initialize band DP: size = 2*K+1, INF = K+1, prev_dp array with d = 0..min(K, len(T)) set to d (capped at INF).

Iterate i from 1 to len(S), compute dp for each valid offset d in [-K, K] where j = i+d is in [0, len(T)], using recurrence: dp[d] = min(prev_dp[d] + mismatch_cost, prev_dp[d+1] + 1, dp[d-1] + 1), capped at INF.
After loop, check if distance for offset d = len(T) - len(S) at row i = len(S) is ≤ K, print "Yes", else "No".
Verify on sample inputs (including edge cases like K=20, large strings up to 500k).
Optimize for speed: use local variables, avoid attribute lookups, consider using array module or list comprehensions.
